faq.q: Which is the best English speaking app in India?
faq.a: It depends on your goal. If you want to speak English confidently in real situations... SpeakX is built exactly for that. Duolingo is good for vocabulary habits, ELSA Speak for focused pronunciation drills, and Cambly or Preply if you want a live human tutor.

faq.q: Can I learn English speaking through Hindi on SpeakX?
faq.a: Yes. SpeakX explains lessons in Hindi and other Indian languages...

faq.q: Is SpeakX better than Duolingo for speaking English?
faq.a: Duolingo is a great habit-building app for many languages. SpeakX focuses only on spoken English for Indian learners... If speaking confidently is your main goal, SpeakX is the more focused choice.

faq.q: Is SpeakX good for complete beginners?
faq.a: Yes. CEFR-aligned paths start from Pre-A1 with explanations in your own language, up to advanced.

faq.q: Can SpeakX help me prepare for a job interview in English?
faq.a: Yes. Interview practice and roleplays, e.g. 'Tell me about yourself', with feedback.

faq.q: Is SpeakX the same as the Speak app?
faq.a: No. SpeakX is an Indian English speaking app made by Ivypods Technology in Gurugram. Speak (speak.com) is a different company.
Sia is SpeakX's AI speaking partner. You can talk with Sia on a voice call inside the app...
Free to download. Premium ₹299/month; new users can try it for 3 days for ₹2 (at the time of writing).

faq.q: How long does it take to improve my spoken English?
faq.a: Depends on start point and regularity; consistency matters more than long sessions; lessons ~15 minutes a day.

issues.detail: All canonical/og:url/sitemap/JSON-LD URLs use https://www.speakx.ai/... but www 308-redirects to https://speakx.ai/... Google will see canonical -> redirect -> non-www; signals split. Fix: generate canonicals, sitemap <loc>, robots Sitemap:, og:url, og:image, Organization.logo/url and BreadcrumbList items as https://speakx.ai/... (or reverse the redirect).

speakx.com, www.speakx.com, speakx.in, www.speakx.in all serve the full site with 200 (not a redirect). They carry a cross-domain canonical to www.speakx.ai, which mitigates but still wastes crawl budget and leaks link equity. Recommend 301 -> https://speakx.ai/$1 at the edge (envoy).
Blog index lists only 7 of 18 posts; 11 posts (all pre-Sept-2026) are reachable only via sitemap/in-article links and have no pagination. Our hub should link to them explicitly where relevant.

Homepage SoftwareApplication.aggregateRating says ratingValue 4.6 / ratingCount 90000 while Google Play shows 4.5 / 92,924 and the content rule forbids '4.6+'. Our pages must use 4.5★ / 92.9K (Play, 2026-10-12) and must not copy the 4.6 figure.

issues.type: copy rule conflict on live site
issues.detail: /premium <title> 'Start Your Free English Speaking Trial' and meta description 'free trial'; llms.txt says 'the free trial'. Page body says trial is ₹2 for 3 days. Shared context forbids 'free trial'. Do not inherit this wording.
Comparison article has 9 <details> FAQs but no FAQPage JSON-LD; also no ItemList for the table. Our /vs pages should add FAQPage + ItemList (as speakshark does).

Two blog posts share the same <title> 'Learn English with an AI Teacher App for Daily Speaking Practice | SpeakX' (learning-english-with-an-ai-teacher-app-for-confident-speaking and how-a-personal-ai-teacher-app-improves-english-speaking-confidence).
Every sitemap <lastmod> is the same generation timestamp (2026-10-12T05:18:30.949Z) - not a real modification date; Google may ignore it.

/favicon.ico 404, /manifest.json 404 (Next metadata uses /icon.png so favicon works in modern browsers); no /press, /news, /awards, /media, /faq, /pricing pages exist (all 404) - the hub's press/awards section will be the first such page.
No hreflang anywhere; html lang=en, Article inLanguage en-IN. Keep consistent (lang=en, inLanguage en-IN).

No GTM; GA4 G-Z36ZMHENFK, Meta pixels (b2c 1191395792230165 / b2b 851507887655950), LinkedIn 10860337 are loaded from the app bundle, so an integrated Next.js build must reuse the site's analytics provider component rather than adding its own tags.
Play screenshot shows 'Urdu' in the in-app native-language picker (8 options incl. English/Urdu) while all copy says 7 Indian languages. Stick to the verified 7.
App Store lists two IAPs: 'SpeakX Premium Monthly ₹299' and 'SpeakX Premium Monthly ₹99'. Only ₹299/month is verified on the website; do not cite ₹99.
